description.value: A double-blind, within-subject, crossover, randomized placebo-controlled study investigated genetic and epigenetic modulation of THC effects on fear-processing brain activation in 36 healthy males using fMRI.

spans.text: We investigated the genetic (  AKT1   rs1130233) and epigenetic modulation of brain function during fear processing in a 2-session, double-blind, cross-over, randomized placebo-controlled THC administration, in 36 healthy males.

description.value: Each participant was tested on two separate occasions at least one month apart in a double-blind, within-subject, crossover design. Participants received 10 mg THC or a matched placebo capsule in pseudo-randomized order and were scanned one hour after administration.

spans.text: As previously reported [ 18 , 34 ], each participant was tested on two separate occasions at least one month apart employing a double-blind, within-subject, crossover design.
